patch.value: Resolve CodeRabbit round-2 findings on PR 16

Eleven findings from the bot review of PR 16: an empty gate-result set deriving a pass verdict, a whitespace bypass of the duplicate-metric refusal, missing atomicity and owner pre-check in sweep planning, alias-resolved degenerate transfer comparison, unanchored section headings, per-environment invalidation caching, duplicate package entries, stored-spec candidate rule, git signing in tests, a helper return type, and a retracted upstream note.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
All eleven findings resolved; every refusal added this round was verified revert-proof (guard reverted, pinned test confirmed to FAIL, restored from git).

- 3836312702 (empty verdict): deriveVerdict now refuses an empty result set with typed code empty_gate_results instead of vacuously passing — an absent measurement can never render as a pass. Revert-proof: with the guard removed the pinned test FAILS.
- 3836312741 (whitespace bypass): metric names are trimmed BEFORE the uniqueness check and the normalized value stored; "reward" and " reward " now collide (invalid_transfer_gaps). Revert-proof verified. Internal spacing differences remain distinct metrics, covered by a dedicated test.
- 3836312710 (plan atomicity): the sweep id itself is pre-checked (sweep_exists) alongside every arm id (sweep_arm_exists), so an ownerless sweep can never be re-armed; a mid-plan failure now removes every arm the invocation wrote (removePlannedArms) and the removal-failure path is refused with BOTH causes named (sweep_cleanup_failed). Proven with injected mid-write failures: a second-create failure leaves zero orphaned runs, and a failing removal surfaces both causes.
- 3836312711 (resolved ids): the degenerate check now compares RESOLVED environment identities after both sides verify; two spellings of one environment (alias-scoped prefix normalized away) are refused. Revert-proof verified.
- 3836312706 (heading anchor): fencedSection anchors headings to a line start; regression test embeds the heading in caller-supplied algorithm text — under the unanchored search the test FAILS (verify reads the wrong fence), with the anchor it passes.
- 3836312715 (caching): staleness reasons are cached per environment id in transfer gap, matching the leaderboard pattern.
- 3836312718 (duplicates): package.json deduplicated.
- 3836312726 (candidate rule): parseSweepSpec now enforces the non-empty candidate array its message states, with the test case.
- 3836312730 (gpgsign): commit.gpgsign=false pinned on every commit/merge in the sweep git-merge test.
- 3836312732 (helper type): plan helper returns Promise<unknown>.
- 3836312746 (upstream note): the UPSTREAM-ISSUES.md entry was retracted entirely — the flagged contract was an error in the instruction file, not the CLI.

Measured gates after all fixes: npm run release:check exit 0; npm test 230/230 pass; coverage 100/100/100 across 17 source files; docstring gate 17 file(s), 124 declaration(s); jscpd 0 clones at the zero-tolerance threshold; ./.bin/pm health --strict-exit green (pinned binary). No threshold lowered, no exclusion added.

patch.value: All eleven CodeRabbit findings resolved with tests; the two new refusals (empty_gate_results, sweep_cleanup_failed) and the normalization/anchor/resolved-id guards each verified revert-proof. Gates: release:check exit 0, 230/230 tests, 100/100/100 coverage across 17 files, docstring 124 declarations, jscpd 0 clones.
